Oregon Ducks QB Dylan Raiola to Start Against UCLA

Dylan Raiola is set to start as quarterback for the Oregon Ducks in their game against UCLA, with teammate Bo Nix ruled out. Raiola's leadership is noted as easing the team's transition at the quarterback position.
